text: Whole milk is soured into dahi with a spoonful of yesterday's dahi or chhach, and the lactic bacteria supply the diacetyl that gives makkhan its aroma. The whole curd, not separated cream, is churned, so makkhan keeps more moisture, curd and lactic acid than butter.

microbes.name: Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis biovar diacetylactis

steps.note: Set at room temperature overnight with a spoonful of the previous day's dahi or chhach, best for churning at 0.9–1.1 % acidity and up to 2 % when uncontrolled.
